incidents.body:
Our platform briefly experienced technical issues between 8:38am CEST and 8:50am CEST.
The incident prevented access to our platform during the period of time.
There were no impact on your data.

We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your understanding.

incidents.body:
Our platform experienced technical issues, preventing most of our users and admins from accessing the platform, starting 11:02 CET today.

We detected the incident shortly after.

We identified the cause of the incident and successfully implemented mitigation measures at 11:35 CET.

The platform was back online shortly after, all systems were fully working at 11:36 CET.

Thank you for your support and understanding.
Please reach out to our support team if you have additional questions.
